berries.text: You find a bush covered with strange blue berries. Some look fresh, others have dark spots.

altar.text: An ancient stone altar stands among the trees. Faded symbols still glow faintly.

broken_cart.text: An abandoned cart lies beside the road. Most of the cargo is gone, but a few crates remain untouched.

footprints.text: Fresh footprints disappear between the trees. They look human... but something seems off.

traveler.text: A tired traveler waves at you from the roadside.

altar.0:
You close your eyes and wait.
For a moment, the forest becomes completely silent. Then the wind returns.
Nothing else happens.
altar.1:
You place a coin on the altar.
-5 gold
The faint symbols glow for a moment before fading again.
altar.2: A warm feeling suddenly fills your body
altar.3: The coin disappears. You hear something move behind you.
altar.4: You leave the strange altar behind and continue down the road.

berries.0:
The berries taste surprisingly sweet +10 maxHP.
A few moments later, you feel a strange warmth spreading through your body.
berries.1:
You carefully pick some of the berries and put them away.
Maybe they will be useful later.
+item in inventory
berries.2:
You decide that eating unknown berries is probably not worth the risk.
Nothing happens

broken_cart.0: You search through the remains of the cargo and find a few useful things hidden beneath the broken boards.
broken_cart.1:
You smash the crate open.
Most of its contents are ruined, but something inside catches your attention.
broken_cart.2: Whatever happened here, you decide it is better not to get involved.

footprints.0: You follow the footprints deeper into the forest. They suddenly disappear.
footprints.1:
You crouch down and examine the tracks.
They are fresh, but something about them bothers you. The footprints look almost human.
footprints.2: You decide that following unknown tracks into the forest is a terrible idea.

traveler.0: The traveler introduces himself and tells you that he has been walking for days. He looks exhausted.
traveler.1: The traveler opens his bag and shows you a few items he is willing to trade.
traveler.2: You walk past the traveler. He watches you disappear down the road.
